translation.title: Corns and Calluses Medicated plaster
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for corns and calluses.
translation.usage: Every 1 to 2 days, place the medicated part in the centre of the patch on the affected area and secure it so that it does not move.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine in the following cases: people who are hypersensitive to this medicine; infants under 2 years of age. Do not use this medicine in the following cases: the area around the eyes; mucous membranes; moist areas; open wounds; irritated or reddened skin; infected areas. Consult a doctor or pharmacist before using this medicine in the following cases: people who are hypersensitive to medicines or cosmetics; women who are pregnant or may be pregnant; diabetes; a circulatory disorder; peripheral neuropathy; people whose affected area is extensive. Symptoms of poisoning may occur, so pregnant women should avoid using it on a large area of skin for a long period. Follow the prescribed dosage and directions. When it is used by a child, use it under the supervision of a guardian. Take care that the medicine does not touch the skin around the affected area. This medicine is for external use only; do not take it by mouth. Stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist if any of the following occur: rash; redness; itching; severe irritation. Store at room temperature, protected from moisture and light. Keep out of reach of children.
